thread:
Maria: dropping the new mock for key management (drawer + bulk actions). two sticky points: bulk rotate UX and how we surface "saved only once" download warnings for newly-created keys. fig: https://design.redwood.local/mock/keys-bulk-rotate.png

Leah: quick skim  love the bulk select chips. question: when rotating multiple keys, do we show one combined modal, or per-key confirmations? combined is faster but may be scary.

AJ: combined modal is OK if we list all affected services and show a clear risk line. need an explicit checkbox: "I understand this will invalidate the selected keys" to reduce accidental rotates.

Sam: accessibility: modal needs focus on the confirm checkbox when shown, and keyboard-only users should be able to confirm without a mouse. also Escape should cancel.

Irina: copy nit for checkbox: use verb-first: "Invalidate selected keys immediately" then smaller hint: "This will stop requests using these keys. Consider rotating one at a time for low-risk services." aria-describedby pointing to the hint.

Maria: for download warning after create: current flow shows a one-line banner saying "copy or download now" which folks miss. propose a required confirmation step: after create, show the key in a persistent panel with a big yellow callout: "Save this key now. You won't be able to see it again." include a primary "Download key" and a secondary "I saved it" so users can acknowledge.

Leah: that might be safer but adds friction. maybe only show the persist panel on first create in a session, or when user hasn't clicked download within 30s. keep it dismissible but record that they've been warned.

AJ: microcopy for the callout: "Store this key securely. It will only be shown once." action: "Download key" + link: "Learn more about storing keys". Make download the primary CTA.

Sam: keyboard + screen-reader flow for download panel: ensure the key is in a text area with aria-label "New API key, copyable" and focus goes to the textarea on open. Also provide a visible "Copy" button with aria-describedby "Copied" status. aria-live polite for the copy-confirmation.

Irina: undo patterns for bulk rotate? After rotate complete, show a summary toast: "Rotated 3 keys  undo" with details link to the activity log. Undo should re-enable old keys for 15s. For screen readers use role="alert" to announce completion. make sure doing undo re-triggers a success announcement.

Maria: layout nit: in the bulk action bar we currently show count, rotate, revoke. Can we reorder: Select all | Actions (Rotate, Revoke) | More (Export)? Actions should be grouped.

Leah: mobile: overflow becomes a bottom sheet. make sure rotate requires confirmation even on small screens, not just a swipe action.

AJ: security note: rotating keys that are in use by Redwood Dedicated customers should surface a policy check: if a key is pinned by a dedicated route, prevent rotation and show explainers linking to route config. small inline lock icon with tooltip.

Sam: test cases to add: keyboard-only rotate, bulk rotate with mixed scope keys (some read-only) should warn if immaterial. also rotate when a key is tagged "immutable" by policy should be blocked.

Irina: accessibility checklist: focus management for drawer open/close, aria-live for toasts (polite for non-blocking, assertive for critical), ensure color contrast for yellow callout, labels for copy buttons, and ensure danger actions are not first in menu order. I'll add these as test items.

Maria: next steps: I'll iterate the mock to add required download confirmation panel, combined rotate modal with checkbox, and inline undo toast behavior. @AJ please refine the CTA labels, @Irina please validate aria attributes after that pass. I'll upload v2 by tomorrow morning.

AJ: will do. small copy proposal for the download panel heading: "One-time key display" and body: "This key is only shown once. Download or copy it now to avoid losing access."

Leah: +1. also add a tiny hint under download: "Tip: use a secrets manager for long-term storage".

UI-bot: automated run: contrast check: PASS for dark mode, FAIL for callout text on low-contrast backgrounds. focus-trap: PASS. keyboard-accessible copy btn: MISSING. Asset uploaded: keys-bulk-v2.fig (https://design.redwood.local/file/keys-bulk-v2)
